claim_scope: external symbolic constructive self-improvement; no neural/HPM checkpoint training

interpretation.supported_statement: In this exact symbolic micro-domain, a bounded constructive loop automatically discovers conservative abstractions from its own solved derivations, retains them only when they reduce held-out search cost, uses them to make deeper abstractions proposal-reachable, and repeats this for multiple generations.

protocol.causal_ablation: remove prior-generation abstractions and re-run the same binary induction budget
protocol.checker: trusted-expansion replay + exact polynomial semantic equality + symbol-scope check
protocol.fixed_final_test: same held-out depth-3 suite evaluated at L0/L1/L2/L3
protocol.induction_budget: mine only complete solved derivations of exactly two actions
protocol.recursive_curriculum: later tasks are generated by composing retained unary identity abstractions
protocol.retention: separate validation tasks; preserve success, reduce action depth, do not increase BFS nodes
